executionArgs.additionalInstruction:
Run security tests against production URL https://flowmapr.com focusing only on these scenarios:
1) Generation limit bypass: authenticated free user at 3/3 used, send POST /api/generate with valid token and tampered headers/body attempts, expect 403 always.
2) Subscription manipulation: as free user attempt POST /api/subscriptions/checkout, POST /api/subscriptions/cancel, and any direct subscription writes via client-side Supabase calls; expect blocked/forbidden by auth/RLS.
3) IDOR on diagrams: User A creates diagram and User B attempts to access User A resources at /workspace/project/[id] and /diagram/[id], expect 404/redirect/no leak.
4) JWT manipulation: modify token claims free->pro and retry protected calls, expect rejection.
5) API rate limit: send 15+ rapid POST /api/generate with valid token, expect 429 after 10 req/min.
Use test account email fedorovaalinavl@gmail.com where applicable. Include request/response evidence and pass/fail per scenario.
